universal_guidelines: Never use pure black #000000; tint with deep midnight blue #0B0F19
Always include data-testid on all interactive and informational elements
Use 2-3x generous spacing (p-6 to p-12, gap-8)
Every page must have a fully responsive header and sticky navigation
Ensure APCA and WCAG AA contrast compliance across all theme states
Provide CSV/XLSX markup rule management, Duffel flight search, checkout, pricing simulator, and CRM sync integration
